name: Joshua Rotenberg
body: Movable Ink's pitch, content personalization and AI decisioning that makes email and mobile programs feel individually built, sits squarely in territory I already work in. At Solenzo, I built a digital-footprint scoring engine that personalizes outreach off real signal instead of a static list, and a full automation system spanning lead capture through close. I've spent 15 years on the technical-implementation side of marketing technology: selling and scoping a CRM/PSA platform itself at Accelo, guiding client onboarding and API integrations as a trusted technical advisor, and translating business intent into working technical configuration.

I want to be direct about where my background doesn't line up cleanly: I haven't worked hands-on inside an enterprise ESP like Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Braze, or Iterable, and I don't have production experience with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, or cloud data warehousing. What I do bring is a track record of picking up complex SaaS platforms fast, at Wix I onboarded and launched 25+ clients a month while holding 120% of sales and 110% of implementation targets, and the same pattern of translating ambiguous business requirements into precise technical configuration that this role calls acting as a universal translator. That's the actual mechanism of the job; the specific platform is what I'd ramp on.
I'd welcome the chance to talk through where that maps to what Movable Ink needs and where I'd need to build depth. I'm available at 303-726-5037 or jrotnbrg@gmail.com.
